title: Puls in Azure: the build and the verbs
caption: The template is the record: one deployment, puls-build, creates what is missing and updates what exists, and the verbs do what a template can't. They read its outputs back: vmPrivateIp, environmentId, environmentStaticIp, sqlServerFqdn, appIdentityId, codingAppIdentityId and vaultUri.
